title: AID Delivery Map — C1 Probe Configuration
description: Per-project delivery probe configuration for the AID C1 Delivery Engine. Defines route discovery parameters, oracle baselines, and probe metadata. All sections are optional; omitted sections cause dependent DG checks to be skipped.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the accuracy of probe configuration.

source.description: How this delivery-map was generated (e.g. 'auto-generated from codebase scan').

routes.description: Route discovery configuration for DG-15 route-resolve check.

framework.description: Routing framework used by the project.

route_files.description: Glob patterns for files that declare routes (e.g. ['src/routes/**/*.tsx']).

link_globs.description: Glob patterns for files containing link components to cross-reference against declared routes (e.g. ['src/**/*.tsx']).

oracle_baselines.description: Named oracle baseline configurations for DG-17 independent-oracle-nodrop check.

analytics_output_file.description: Path to the file whose cardinality should be checked.

expected_cardinality.description: Minimum expected number of rows or items in the output file.

cardinality_method.description: Method used to count items in the output file. Defaults to jq_length.
